architect_blocker.contract_disposition: The accepted contract, schemas, public surface, codes, stage ordering and branch behavior remain unchanged. This correction makes the implementation match the already frozen request-before-plan order and retained named-lineage rule.
required_correction: Refactor only _inputs so it opens and retains prepared first, reads the fixed request, and completes strict JSON, schema/correlation and canonical-byte validation before attempting to open or read plan.

Establish a request-phase verifier immediately after prepared is bound. On every exception from request read/parse/schema/semantic/canonical work, verify the retained session and prepared descriptor, reopen named prepared from the retained batch, compare its directory identity, and, once request bytes/identity exist, compare the named request identity and exact bytes.
Only after request semantics succeed, open and bind plan. On every later exception, reopen every named directory already bound in that phase and compare all fixed-file identities/bytes already read.

An observed named prepared/request or later plan/plan-file replacement must raise sanitized WORK_PATH_UNSAFE and override the earlier exception. If plan has not yet been opened or bound, a missing or changing plan must not preempt a request semantic error.

Preserve the one retained checkout/work/batch session, the existing _Inputs full verifier, plan-before-blob semantics after request success, all create/reuse behavior, public APIs, result bytes and error domains.
